card.fires_on: Path pieces inside web addresses, such as wiki, library or handbook, and the middle of surnames in citations, such as Frog-uel or Fer-ri.

modes.label: URL path pieces
modes.description: A folder or site name partway through a web address, just before a slash.

modes.label: Inside surnames
modes.description: The middle or end of a person's name in a reference or byline, before the name is complete.
